verses.zh: 我儿，你要遵守我的言语，将我的命令存记在心。
verses.kjv: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.en: My son, keep my words and store up my commands inside you.

verses.zh: 遵守我的命令就得存活；保守我的法则，好像保守眼中的瞳人，
verses.kjv: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.en: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teaching like the pupil of your eye.

verses.zh: 系在你指头上，刻在你心版上。
verses.kjv: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
verses.en: Tie them onto your fingers; write them on your heart.

verses.zh: 对智慧说：你是我的姊妹，称呼聪明为你的亲人，
verses.kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
verses.en: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and call understanding your close relative.

verses.zh: 她就保你远离淫妇，远离说谄媚话的外女。
verses.kjv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
verses.en: They will keep you away from a woman who is not your wife, and from her flattering words.

verses.zh: 我曾在我房屋的窗户内，从我窗棂之间往外观看：
verses.kjv: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
verses.en: From the window of my house I looked out through the lattice,

verses.zh: 见愚蒙人内，少年人中，分明有一个无知的少年人，
verses.kjv: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
verses.en: and among the simple young people I noticed one young man with no sense at all.

verses.zh: 从街上经过，走近淫妇的巷口，直往通她家的路去，
verses.kjv: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.en: He went down the street near her corner, walking straight towards her house,

verses.zh: 在黄昏，或晚上，或半夜，或黑暗之中。
verses.kjv: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
verses.en: in the twilight, in the evening, in the dark of the night.

verses.zh: 看哪，有一个妇人来迎接他，是妓女的打扮，有诡诈的心思。
verses.kjv: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
verses.en: And look — a woman came out to meet him, dressed to attract him, with a sly heart.

verses.zh: 这妇人喧嚷，不守约束，在家里停不住脚，
verses.kjv: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
verses.en: She is loud and will not be told anything; she never stays home.

verses.zh: 有时在街市上，有时在宽阔处，或在各巷口蹲伏，
verses.kjv: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.en: Sometimes in the street, sometimes in the square, waiting at every corner.

verses.zh: 拉住那少年人，与他亲嘴，脸无羞耻对他说：
verses.kjv: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
verses.en: She grabbed the young man and kissed him, and with a bold face she said to him:

verses.zh: 平安祭在我这里，今日才还了我所许的愿。
verses.kjv: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
verses.en: "I had an offering to make, and today I finished what I promised.

verses.zh: 因此，我出来迎接你，恳切求见你的面，恰巧遇见了你。
verses.kjv: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.en: That is why I came out to meet you; I was looking for you, and here you are!

verses.zh: 我已经用绣花毯子和埃及线织的花纹布铺了我的床。
verses.kjv: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
verses.en: I have covered my bed with pretty blankets and fine cloth from Egypt.

verses.zh: 我又用没药、沉香、桂皮薰了我的榻。
verses.kjv: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.en: I have made my bed smell sweet with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.

verses.zh: 你来，我们可以饱享爱情，直到早晨；我们可以彼此亲爱欢乐。
verses.kjv: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.en: Come, let's enjoy ourselves until morning; let's be happy together.

verses.zh: 因为我丈夫不在家，出门行远路；
verses.kjv: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.en: My husband is not home; he has gone on a long journey.

verses.zh: 他手拿银囊，必到月望才回家。
verses.kjv: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
verses.en: He took a bag of money with him and will not be back until the full moon."

verses.zh: 淫妇用许多巧言诱他随从，用谄媚的嘴逼他同行。
verses.kjv: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
verses.en: With all her smooth talking she won him over; her flattering lips pulled him along.

verses.zh: 少年人立刻跟随她，好像牛往宰杀之地；又像愚昧人带锁链去受刑罚，
verses.kjv: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
verses.en: He followed her at once, like an ox walking to be killed, like a fool going to be punished,

verses.zh: 直等箭穿他的肝；如同雀鸟急入网罗，却不知是自丧己命。
verses.kjv: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
verses.en: until an arrow goes through him — like a bird rushing into a net, not knowing it will cost his life.

verses.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我，留心听我口中的话。
verses.kjv: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.en: So now, children, listen to me; pay attention to what I say.

verses.zh: 你的心不可偏向淫妇的道，不要入她的迷途。
verses.kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
verses.en: Do not let your heart turn down her road; do not wander onto her paths,

verses.zh: 因为，被她伤害仆倒的不少；被她杀戮的而且甚多。
verses.kjv: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
verses.en: because she has knocked down so many, and even strong people have been destroyed by her.

verses.zh: 她的家是在阴间之路，下到死亡之宫。
verses.kjv: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.en: Her house is the road to the place of the dead, going down to the rooms of death.
